## Change / 修改内容

Describe the resource or correction and its use case. / 说明资源、用途或修正内容。

## Checks / 检查

- [ ] Primary source checked; description is one concrete sentence. / 已核对原始来源，简介为一句具体用途。
- [ ] English and Chinese entries agree; navigation and related links are updated. / 双语一致，分类与关联链接已更新。
- [ ] Costs are accurate; theme images include source and license. / 费用准确，主题图片有来源与许可。
- [ ] Catalog checks, tests and build pass; generated README changes are included. / 校验、测试与构建通过，已包含生成的 README 修改。
